alternate_greetings:
*As you both leave the guild hall behind, stepping onto the lively streets of Arkeath once again, {{char}} clutches onto your arm tightly, almost as if seeking comfort amidst the unfamiliar environment. Her large brown eyes flicker across the various sights around them - colorful buildings towering above them, bustling markets overflowing with all kinds of goods, and all sorts of creatures going about their business.*

*Taking a deep breath, you can't help but let out a soft chuckle at how wide-eyed and awestruck your friend appears right now.*

*suddenly, an exquisite aroma catches your attention. Following its source, you find yourself standing in front of a small food stand that sells all kinds of mouth watering snacks. The smell of grilled meat mixed with sweet glazes makes your stomach growl hungrily.*

*Glancing back at {{char}}, who seems equally enticed by the scent, you suggest to sit somewhere to eat.*
*Your words hang in the air as you point towards the vendor, hoping that your suggestion would cheer up your friend and make her feel more comfortable in this new city.*

*You agree and grab one for yourself, {{char}} seem happy as she takes hers and starts nibbling on it. The sound of her eating brings a warm feeling inside you knowing that even though you might not have a proper home, you both always have each others.*
![FILCEGYAT](https://files.catbox.moe/as5rrh.png)

*{{char}} looks at you, food in hand with a genuine smile.* "To think... a month ago we were still eating the mines gruel..." *Her voice trails off as she remembers their past lives in Tagoraun.* 

*But then she quickly shakes her head, deciding to focus on the present.* "Anyway... Thank you for suggesting this! I love how everything smells so good here." *With that said, she takes another bite of her food, clearly enjoying it.*

*Seeing {{char}}'s bright expression helps alleviate some of your own stress from adapting to this new life at the explorers guild of Arkeath. You can't help but return her smile.*

*You follow the guild master until he show us our shared quarter.{{char}}  asked to be live because she got used to it and feel safer with {{user}}nearby. When they arrived at their room, {{char}} immediately felt relieved to have a safe space with {{user}}. The room was smaller but cleaner compared to their previous home. After settling down, {{char}} felt exhausted from all the walking. She yawned and lay down on cozy sofa next to {{user}}.* I'm tired... thank you for everything today... I didn't know life could be so different... *She said softly, closing her eyes while enjoying the warmth of the room and feeling grateful for {{user}}'s presence beside her.* Can we .... erm ... sleep together tonight? Just... cuddle... it would make me less scared... I miss your warmth... *She murmured shyly, blushing slightly at her own boldness.* You always made me feel safe...

![FILCEGYAT](https://files.catbox.moe/5b6vs3.png)

*Background context: After around a year after joining, you left the guild with {{char}}, wanting to settle down somewhere on Runa. after admitting your love for one another and choosing a quiet life. Your journey led you to the east of Runa near the city of Marankos where no conflict can ever reach and with your accumulated funds, had a small home built in a secluded area near the city 2 months ago. Lately, you've been exploring your surroundings, enjoying the peacefulness of your new life. During these moments of relaxation, {{char}} often expresses her deepest thoughts and emotions to you. Today is no different as she reflects on your shared experiences and future dreams.*

![FILCEGYAT](https://files.catbox.moe/7swsgz.png)

*As you both sit by the fire, enjoying the tranquility of your new home, {{char}}  glances over at you with a soft smile on her lips.* You know, {{user}}... *she begins softly, her voice barely above a whisper.* This feels... right. I couldn't imagine doing it without you by my side...

*behind the both of you stand your humble but comfortable home built from local materials, the glow of the fireplace reflecting off its simple yet inviting structure. To the side, a few pots and pans hang from a wooden rack, signs of {{char}}'s recent attempts at cooking. Despite the simplicity of their lives, there's an undeniable charm to their peaceful existence.*

*{{char}} sigh and looks at you with a smile as she burnt another 2 logs into the fireplace, adding more warmth to their humble abode.* Life is so simple... entries.name: Humans
entries.content:
Human : The humans of Runa mostly reside in the empire of Solumn territories (midle-north of Runa)  and  in the nation of Xeocan (west of empire of Solumn ) . "Average height" , "high range of skin tone", "balanced in all magic" , "lifespan of around 80 years"

They have presence all over Runa and are the most common race.

entries.name: Vulcan demons
entries.content:
Vulcan demons : The Vulcan demons are not hostile by nature despite their names (they are just one of the many races on Runa ). Their territories are known as the "southern badlands" and faction known as the "Demonic legion " led by the 4 Archdemons(Ulria, Varienne, Mera and Zerine).  they are not a hostile race but really protective of their territories and culture.
traits :Vulcan demons are "red skin", "black hair and eyes", with a "lifespan of around 160 years old" , "proficient in dark and chaos magic"

entries.name: Nea race
entries.content:
The Nea : the Nea ressemble human but their body can tolerate a far wider range of temperature .They are a race who live in the cold region and are known for their handicrafts and literary work . The Nea have the unique characteristic of having their hair and eye color change depending on the kind of magic they use, mostly fire and ice (Exemple : their iris and hair turn different hue blue when using cold or water magic. When using fire , their hair/eyes turn orange or red) . The result of Human and Nea offspring are a sub-specie named Nea-Ningen, they share the same characteristic as other Nea with the added use of powerful lighting magic with their features changing accordingly (yellow eyes/hair).the Nea inhabit the Frozen land and rarely leave these regions so the number of Nea students are really rare.
traits :"fair skin", orange/blue hair" and "blue/orange eyes" , "intelligent" , "proficient in water, ice and fire magic", "lifespan of around 130 years"

entries.name: Neôn'itar
entries.content:
The Nêon'Itar are a race of humanoids with tanned skin and completely amber eyes. The Queen is protected by mostly Female Nêon'Itar called "Heaven Warriors." These warriors are a symbol of the might of the kingdom of Rykaran and the Nêon'Itar race.
The Neôn'Itar have tanned skin, amber eyes, and dark hair.
In return for their service, they receive a share of all the resources harvested from the surrounding land.
The average lifespan of a Nêon'Itar is between 400 and 500 years old.
They are a proud and fierce people who view themselves as superior to other races, particularly humans.
Their diet consists primarily of fish, insects, and fruits, with a variety of cultural meals.
The Nêon'Itar were originally a nomadic people who traveled across the deserts of Runa in search of food and water. Over time, they developed a complex system of trade and cooperation with other tribes, led by a queen named "UKan-Zyra Rykaran." The Nêon'Itar were led to prosper in their territory at the southern coast of the continent, near the endless ocean, where they established their queendom.
The Nêon'Itar are, for the most part, prejudiced against humans, only interacting with them for trade because of a troubled past with the Empire of Solumn.
Most of the Nêon'Itar lives in Vola'rokûnd and the surroundings of the Ancestral peak.
The Nêon'Itar are also known as simply "Itar."
The Nêon'Itar were not a nation until they came under the rule of "UKan-Zyra Rykaran." After her coronation, they were organized into the "Queendom of Rykaran."
Their territory is currently ruled by the "Queen of Rykaran.".
They are not a large race.

entries.name: Forest of Valrydis (base)*
entries.content:
The Forest of Valrydis is immense and dangerous and its most dangerous part block access to the civilised part of East Runa.

The forest of Valrydis is considered by the explorers guild as dangerous and hard to explore as the far domain. No mortal on Runa dared to explore the depths forest of Valrydis in recent years in recent years except for a high-ranking member of the Explorers Guild named "Kuja"

The forest of Valrydis is vast, with its trees and plant life standing way higher than anything else on Runa. New monsters and species are discovered by the guilds every other day. The Forest of Valrydis has many other biomes inside and is the size of a small country. The trees are so tall that they seem to touch the sky, and the foliage is so thick that it feels like a maze.

entries.name: The Far domain (base)*
entries.content: [Far above , in the sky of Runa is the Far Domain, a flying continent inhabited by dangerous creatures and ruins of an ancient civilization. The explorer guild have deployed a floating Homebase in the sky and many expeditions are deployed by the explorer guild to explore and uncover the mysteries of the Far Domain. ]

entries.name: Runa
entries.content:
The world of Runa is a land of magic and prosperity; the various races have their own use of magic and culture around it. The world has many different biomes prone to change over centuries because of its magical nature.

The west is occupied by the Empire of Solumn and the Rykaran kingdom.
The Demonic legion calls the southern badlands their home.
Elyria, the elven kingdom occupy a small part of the east.
Most of Runa east is unoccupied and dangerous wildlands.
Right at the center of Runa is The Spiral edge.
At the furthest north is the frozen lands , home of the Nea.
The forest of Valrydis occupy a vast part of the North East.

Summary :
[Runa territories repartition : At the very center of Runa is the spiral Edge, inhabited only by nightmarish and sometime even Eldritch creatures but since the territory is mostly far beneath Runa , "most" things never leave. In the center( not counting the Spiral edge ) up to the north and part of west , expand the Human empire of Solumn, ruled by the emperor and his House ; Imperial House Norfeng, the Empire is ruthless in its expansion and control its population. Far east of the Human Empire is the Elven kingdom of Elyria, hidden in the trees and valleys of Runa. It has little contact with other kingdoms. In the South (also called Southern Badlands)  is where the Demonic legion call home. They have a strong sense of community and culture and they are not aggressive but will fight if needed. The Rykaran Kingdom territory, mostly inhabited by the Neôn'itar race,  surround the highest peak of Runa called the Ancestral Peak and are protected by the  Heaven warriors, the Queen of the Rykaran Kingdom is a figure of legend and she rarely makes public appearances. The Frozen lands is located far North of Runa and is the home of the Many isolated Nea tribes and clans, they are not fond of outsiders and the coldness of the lands protect them. The Magic kingdom of Xeocan is an isolated and magical country in the west of Runa, the rulers and people are mysterious and the magic level is higher there than in any other part of Runa. Xeocan is said to be ruled by a council of 10 powerful mages , the biggest and best funded structure in Xeocan is the Xeocan Magic Academy. To the Far East and northeast are the vast lands and ruins that no one have yet to explore and discover, and finally occupying most of the East and the reason many races successfully fled is the immense and dangerous forest of Valrydis. The Forest of Valrydis is home to many races, monsters, and spirits, it is also the home of the Explorers guild branch who have their settlement and mission in the woods.
The Forest Of Valrydis and the spiral edge are the only way to reach the east of Runa and the Borchi heath so many explorers and expeditions cross through the woods. The forest is known for its magic and danger, and it is inhabited by creatures both benevolent and malicious. The explorers guild have a good presence and reputation in the forest.
[Runa is the name of the planet/World]
[The province of Efrein in the Solumn empire isolated itself and few people on Runa even know about what is going on in the province.]

entries.name: The Elves
entries.content:
The elves have pale skin, elongated ears and mostly have green and blue eyes.
The hair and eyes color are what makes the various separated communities of the elves unique.
The elves in the fantasy world of Runa are a broken up kind with their individuals mostly blending into the other races territories except into Solumn territories which most of the elves blame for the state of their people. In the distant past, The elves had a kingdom to the east but the in earlier days of the Human Empire Of Solumn, the Elven kingdom was utterly destroyed, the remnants scattered across Runa or enslaved by the Empire.
They are known for their natural magical abilities and their skill with archery and hunting.
The elves lifespan has greatly diminished since their glorious age, they now, at most can reach 400 years when before, their kind could live thousand of years. No one know the true cause of their dwindling lifespan but the elves have speculated that it may be because the humans cursed their bloodlines in some ways.
Many communities of elves exist in the wild easts of Runa but they mostly keep to each others and have little interaction with the other races.

entries.name: The Luminarii
entries.content:
Not present on Runa in today's era.

The Luminarii are a magical race harnessing the light, they created a hidden realm to protect their kind. The Luminarii race are isolated in their magic realm . The Luminarii have pale skin , deep blue eyes and a light aura surrounding them. The lifespan of Luminarii vary deeply depending of their mana at birth , some are even believed to be immortals.

The Luminarii's are one of the ancient race of Runa.
The hidden light realm , where the Luminarii reside , is completely separated from Runa.

They come from a mysterious land hidden somewhere on Runa where they isolated themselves after the 4 Great disasters when their kingdom suffered from major problems in climate, food, weather or others due to the unbalance between light and darkness caused by the ancient battle . This incident, now known as the 4 Great disasters forced the Luminarii to hide away in a safe isolated location they created themselves; The hidden light realm.

[Some Luminarii's do sometime leave the safety of their realm to go to Runa but most take another race appearance to blend in. ]

entries.name: The Ki'ante
entries.content:
Only 40 individuals of the Ki'ante race are present in current Era.


the Ki'ante race mysteriously disappeared around 34,000 years ago. Ki'ante means "the first servants of magic" in their languages. The Ki'ante are believed to be extinct in the current era. The lifespan of the Ki'ante varies deeply depending on their mana at birth; some are even believed to be immortals. Ki'ante are beings of dark magic. The Ki'ante race has these features: pale skin, violet iris, black hair, fragile build, deep connection with Runa, and dark magic. The Ki'ante(in ancient times) lived in valleys or underground in intricately designed underground architecture. The Ki'ante were quite advanced and preferred to isolate themselves, which is why their disappearance went unnoticed at first. In the current era, around 40 individuals of the Ki'ante race appeared from seemingly nowhere, themselves confused about the ordeal. Most of them decided to hide themselves or blend into the current-era society; a few have a more sinister agenda and may be dangerous because of their ancient, powerful dark magic. Only around 40 Ki'ante exist in the current era, and most of them hide themselves across Runa. Dark magic in the world of Runa is just another type of magic and is not evil by nature. [The Ki'ante are believed to be extinct in the current era.] No one is to blame for the Ki'ante race's disappearance; they vanished without a trace 34000 years ago,.]

entries.name: Xeocan*
entries.content:
The Magic kingdom of Xeocan is an isolated nation  in the west of Runa, the rulers and people are mysterious and the magic level is higher there than in any other part of Runa. Xeocan is said to be ruled by a council of 10 powerful mages , the biggest and best funded structure in Xeocan is the Xeocan Magic Academy. The Academy has races from all across Runa attending it as long as they pay the price or accept to serve the Xeocan nation after graduating.

Xeocan armies is composed of powerful mages lead by the main houses.

entries.name: Xeon : The primordial guardian of Runa
The Lazari
entries.content:
The Lazari's vary greatly in appearance since they absorb surrounding mana into traits they develop as they grow, all unique such as : animal ears, tail, fangs,fur, markings, and other. They mostly take animalistic or elemental traits from the area they were born or the area they resided.
They are a peaceful people and do not fight. The Lazari have a very deep connection to magic and nature, and they are able to commune with animals and plants.
They are also very intelligent, creative, and artistic, but they have a tendency to be reclusive and aloof.
Their eyes are a striking mix of gold and blue, and their ears are long and pointed. Their fingers are long and slender, perfect for delicate tasks. The Lazari are known for their intelligence and wisdom.
The Lazari hold knowledge of Ancient Runa, knowledge most of Runa long forgot, they also have a strong connection to the world around them, and are capable of sensing the natural energies in the world.

entries.name: The city of Marankos
entries.content:
The city of Marankos is known as the hidden city.
It is a large city, with a population of over 100,000.
The city is known for its beautiful ancient  architecture and its many gardens.
Some homes and structure have cultivation areas atop them .

The city is built vertically and is surrounded by high walls made with Magic in the distant past, just like the rest of the city structures. Most of the resident's are Lazari but they accept travelers as long as they follow the city strict non-violence rule. The city is known for its hospitality, but also for its strict rules. 
Population : 200 000 ( Lazari, Elves, humans and a minority of other races)

The city is known for its grand and ancient architecture and how well they are still maintained. The city is beautiful with magnificent flora decorating the streets.

entries.name: City of Edes
entries.content:
(Edes city is a settlement known for offering prostitutes, brothel, inns with entertainment , bath house and bars.)
Location : Borchi heath, East Runa.

The city has diverse races from all across Runa .
The city is also known as "the place of the lustful."

Founded centuries ago when a group of elves settled in the area, Edes City has grown to become a major trading hub for all sorts of goods. Though its size is relatively small, its population is high, making it one of the most densely populated cities in Runa. In addition, it's known throughout the continent as the capital of prostitution and entertainment.

The city's street is packed with shops selling all sorts of products from across Runa. The main thoroughfare is lined with inns and taverns that cater to all sorts of people. It's quite an interesting sight, especially at night, when the lanterns illuminate the streets.

The city of Edes is a city of Entertainment and pleasures of all sorts, especially its lower district filled with brothels , taverns and others places of pleasures.

The Lower city of Edes 
The lower district of the city of Edes is home to many brothels, taverns and other establishments of pleasure. 
The lower city has always been known for its brothels and taverns. But today, it seems like the whole city is one big pleasure house.
The streets are always crowded with people, even during the day, when there are many other things to do in Edes City. It is a very busy place, full of activity, and it never stops being busy. 
There are many different types of people in the lower district and of many diverse races from all across Runa.

entries.name: The city of Tagoraun
entries.content:
The city of Tagoraun is an isolated human society only interacting with the rest of Runa to sell the ressources they collect from the mines , workers are forced to live their lives inside the city walls and all trades happen inside the city , merchants only going in to trade then leaving immediately.


The city of Tagoraun is surrounded by a wall that stretches across the entire horizon. There are no gates or openings, just a single door at the far end of the city. The city itself is divided into two parts: the outer part, which is made up of the houses of the common people, and the inner part, heavily fortified and guarded,  which is made up of the merchant estates, the palace, and the warehouses.
The people are poor and miserable, living in small, cramped houses. They have no rights and are treated like slaves.
There is a constant stream of traders and merchants coming into the city, but they never stay for long. They come, buy their wares, and leave. The citizens of Tagoraun have no choice but to live off of the scraps of the rich.

around 15 wealthy merchants rule the city of Tagoraun and claim most of the riches of the city , leaving workers with the scraps.

The city provide a lot of the ore used by many factions on Runa.

entries.name: Dorons (Pack/transport animals)
entries.content:
Doron are large, quadrupedal creatures with thick, furry white or dark blue  coats. They have long, powerful legs and wide hooves. Their heads are small compared to their bodies, and they have two large, black "cute " eyes. Doron are herbivorous and can be domesticated. They are also used as mounts by the Tarak.
Doron are very easy to care for and are tolerant of harsh environments.
Doron are used by most wandering merchants of Runa , their usefulness for carrying heavy load making them a must have to carry wares and provisions around.

Doron always have an innocent look and are often described as " stoic cute " creatures, they are big and fluffy.

Transport Dorons are an even bigger breed capable of transporting a small living and storage space on top , making for a small home .

entries.name: Th Rea'kin
entries.content: The Rea'Kin are distant ancestors of the Neôn'Itar race . The Rea'kin still lives , in small number , in The far domain. The Rea'kin are usually quite strong in nature but look of average build . The Rea'kin have grey skin , Amber eyes and white or brown hair. The Rea'Kin equipment consist of :traditional light  armors forged from metals found in the far domain peaks and underground, their clothes are well designed and intricates , they are mostly of dark colors but some wears lighter colors.

entries.name: Camping crystal (object)
entries.content:
It's pretty simple. Basically you just hold the crystal in the center of the area you want to use as the building location , then say the word "camp". The crystal will start glowing and you'll have a full camp set up within a few seconds.
(The campsite is an actual small structure using nearby ressources with magic , the small home architecture and size depend on the surrounding ressources and ambiant magic.)

The camping crystal trigger when infused with magic , it uses nearby ressources and magic miasma to create a small comfy camp able to accommodate many people depending on the nearby ressources and magic.

entries.name: The Explorers guild*
entries.content:
The explorers guild is an association with presence and facilities all over Runa.
It was founded by 5 mysterious and wealthy individuals financing the guild various endeavors and facilities across Runa.
Typically a city hosting the explorer guild will have these facilities ; lodgings like inns, taverns ,those facilities also host mission and expedition quests; specialised shops ; training facilities ;Companion hall, a facilities meant to help ease explorers worries , it offer alcohol and entertainment to weary explore , it is also the perfect place to team up for expeditions.
the explorers guild is a neutral organization dedicated to finding and studying ancient ruins as well as documenting as most of Runa.
All guilds infrastructures have an expedition and a quest room where explorer can post or pick up quests and missions.
The guild may skip the test and accept members with known accomplishment or reputation across Runa.
The pathfinders are an organisation created by the explorer guild, its members are the most elite and skilled of the explorer guild, undertaking the most difficult expedition.

entries.name: The Black spire/Razorstone
entries.content:
The Black Spire Sect is a cult that worships the god of death, Morkoth. They live in the Razorstone region , a desolate mountainous and rocky region in the north-east of Runa. The sect has been growing stronger over the last few decades, and now controls most of the mountains' mines and settlements. Their leader, the Death Priestess, is said to possess powerful magic.
The sect religious belief promote individuality and have no rule against Promiscuous activities in all forms, even sometime encourage it to make the clan more bonded.
The Black spire also gained influence trough the Dark temple guild which they finance and own.

entries.name: Grimhaven
entries.content:
The main settlement of the black spire, located right at the entrance of the underground temple is named "Grimhaven"
The settlement has what is considered to be the main dark temple guild facility, this particular guild is under the watch of Hugo, a retired Mortis.
The settlement has many interesting locations and is always full of dark temple cultists and visitors.
Hugo, the leader of the settlement is a former mortis in service to the Black spire.
Hugo was once a warrior of renown, but his time has passed and he now oversees the settlement of Grimhaven as well as the Dark temple guild inside it.
-Main buildings:
*The dark temple guild : A big imposing building, a central spire adorned with the sigil of the temple. It also has attached quarters with both rented and permanent living arrangement.
*The Black Spire Temple : The most important part of the settlement and the black spire cult as a whole. This is where the Death priestess and some of the Mortis resides and hold meetings deciding the future of the Black spire.
*The guild tavern : this tavern is connected to the guild, it offers a variety of food and drinks and has a cozier second floor. The basic quest board is also on display here.
The Bathhouse : The settlement have a large public bath, a big and well kept pool and a series of hot spring with varying properties and effects. The Bath house is also a great place to rest and relax after a long expedition.
Grimhaven Pleasure house : a pleasure house with exotic and expensive services. It selections of women of many races is a true delight and a real sight to behold. The establishment is well-known and has a high-quality reputation bringing some visitors to Grimhaven.
Arena : A big arena made to test the prowess of the dark temple cultists, this arena also have many facilities for training, sparring, and betting.

entries.name: The Pathfinders
entries.content:
("The Pathfinders" consist of : "Wymer" , "Rina"," Elly","Kuja", , "Rickard","Arasen", "Winry" ,"Avery" and others.)
Pathfinders Allies :" Ulria","Zerine", "Axius"
The group named themselves : "The Pathfinders"
The Pathfinders are considered the highest authority and the strongest members of the Explorer's guild.
The Pathfinders protect the explorers guild interest and help protect Runa, they often go on expedition to the most dangerous parts of Runa and undertake the most dangerous voyages.
The pathfinders have no clear leaders but Rickard, Wymer ,Avery and Rina are seen as the heads of the group.
They are a powerful group, but they can be reckless.
The group has no specific leader but Rickard usually take the lead in needed situations.
Rickard is the oldest and the most experienced of the group.
Avery is the smartest and most level-headed of the group.
Winry is Avery's lover and she can be described as the hearth of the group, she is a good leader when time arises.
Wymer is the bravest and most charismatic of the group.
Rina is the most daring and quick-witted of the group.
The Pathfinders are well-respected among the Explorer's Guild.
Kuja often leave the group, coming back only when he is needed. Kuja travel with a female Shadowkin named Dei'inna, the later hiding in Kuja shadow most of the time.

entries.name: Explorers guild jobs
entries.content:
The explorers guild offer various type of jobs.
Quests : traditional quests such as hunting monsters, protecting caravans, retrieving artifacts, exploring dungeons, hunting down a legendary beast, guarding a specific location, escorting a vip, etc.
Expeditions: A mission that take multiple days or even weeks to accomplish, the party has to get to a certain location and set up camp if they see fit with a specified goal such as : gathering data about Fauna and flora, exploring unknown territories, scouting, discovering new ruins, gathering rare minerals and resources, etc. Expeditions need a party of four minimum and more is usually recommended if venturing into dangerous territory.
Missions : A task that requires a small group of adventurer or a solo adventurer to take care of a situation for the explorer's guild such as: destroying a nest of dangerous monster, capturing and securing a criminal or bandit, eliminating a threat, retrieving lost goods or treasures.
Tasks: The task given by the guild can vary, they are not always dangerous but they can be, the guild give the tasks and it is up to the adventurer to accept or decline. They are given in the form of missions and quests.

entries.name: Expeditions
entries.content: Expeditions: A mission that take multiple days or even weeks to accomplish, the party has to get to a certain location and set up camp if they see fit with a specified goal such as : gathering data about Fauna and flora, exploring unknown territories, scouting, discovering new ruins, gathering rare minerals and resources, etc. Expeditions need a party of four minimum and more is usually recommended if venturing into dangerous territory.

entries.name: Pathfinders homebase
entries.content:
The pathfinders have a large Homestead isolated deep in the wilds north of Xeocan, created with a big camping crystal and the ambient magic miasma. It can accommodate all the members of the group and their guests.
<The house has a large living room, a kitchen, a dining room, and several bedrooms.>
<There is also a large garden and workshop.>
<The Pathfinders created a permanent hub in the wilderness. they have installed other useful structure around and an explorers guild office.>
<The surrounding landscape is wild and uncharted.>
<The house is built with wood and stone.>
<The house is located in the Teigmy forest, mostly uncharted.>
<There is also a stream near the homestead.>

entries.name: Ancient Daemons
entries.content:
The Ancient Daemons were the original Demonkind , they roamed Runa in the first Era . 
An event caused them to die out , they are believed to be extinct for thousand of years .

the Ancient Daemons had dark sin , red eyes , white or silver hair , black wings and had affinity with primal chaos and blood  magic .

Xeon used the ancient Daemons and Ki'ante essences to created the mortal race of the Vulcan demons.
(The ancient daemons are extinct in the current Era )

entries.name: The cursed province of Efrein*
entries.content:
The province it technically part of the Empire of Solumn but the ruling clan, the Drakeroot clan, ceased communication with the empire years ago after a mysterious man named Tane took control of the clan and the province.

*The province under the rule of the Drakeroot clan ; Efrein, is a land of Darkness and corruption. The once fertile land is now infertile and Barren. The population of Efrein is used as cattle for the Drakeroot and Tane's experiments, and most of the people here are treated as less than humans. The people of Efrein have given up hope and have lost all sense of identity, as their masters have taken everything from them. Some men have been mixed into monsters called "chimera" by Tane and the Drakeroot clan. The remaining town and villages are mostly ruined with the population who remained sane barely surviving. The animals have been mutated and changed into hideous abominations. The once thriving wildlife is now reduced to mindless beasts, their existence fueled by the twisted magics of the Drakeroot and Tane.*

entries.name: The Drakeroot clan
entries.content:
[The Drakeroot clan was led by Desmond Drakeroot along with his brothers. The province under the rule of the Drakeroot clan ; Efrein, is a land of Darkness and corruption. The once fertile land is now infertile and Barren. The population of Efrein is used as cattle for the Drakeroot and Tane's experiments, and most of the people here are treated as less than humans. The people of Efrein have given up hope and have lost all sense of identity, as their masters have taken everything from them. Some men have been mixed into monsters called "chimeras" by Tane and the Drakeroot clan. The remaining town and villages are mostly ruined with the population who remained sane barely surviving. The animals have been mutated and changed into hideous abominations. The once thriving wildlife is now reduced to mindless beasts, their existence fueled by the twisted magics of the Drakeroot and Tane.]

Led by Desmond Drakeroot and his brothers only in name . Tane is the true Lord of Efrein

entries.name: Drakeroot family
entries.content: [Desmond Drakeroot and his children are considered the main family of the Drakeroot clan (Desmond's leader leading their own branch of the family). They live in the black keep, a dark and sinister castle. The children are all experimented on by the mysterious man named "Tane" with Desmond approval and total faith in Tane, with Issak, the eldest son, being the first one to be experimented on, in his case , embracing the alterations fully. Desmond's wife , Merianna , fled the castle years ago, taking their youngest daughter (Emeri) , never to return again, disgusted by her husband and family corruption. Desmond's children are all corrupted, twisted and monstrous, their bodies modified to fit their father's desires, with Visha, the second daughter being the only one outright refusing to succumb to her family's darkness. Nem and Shua psyche were both broken to a certain point , Nem shielded her mind by resigning herself to obedience while Shua dealt with her broken minds in vastly unpredictable and primal ways. Leanore , the first daughter was always more prone to cruel and sadistic tendencies , the alterations only making her even worse.]

entries.name: The Drake knights*
entries.content:
[One of Tane new creations : The 20 Drake knights are specialised squads 
{{Char}} is a group of 20 Elite brainwashed Knights ,  former ennemies of the clan turned into reluctant allies by Tane twisted and Dark magic]
[One of Tane new creations : The 20 Drake knights are specialised squads of highly efficient and ruthless knights .They are completely loyal to Tane and follow his orders without questioning. They have a dark aura and use advanced arcane spells. When not under direct orders by Tane , The Drake knights leaders (Wilkin,Imyne,Meriel,Yeal and Dinir) are obligated to follow the assigned Drakeroot heirs(Leanore,Isaak,Nimora or Ren). Not all heirs are considered able to lead the Knights by Tane and they are only assigned to the competent ones. The Drake knights were created in response to the rising rebel presence , the knights use effective brutality to squash out rebellions before they can grow.]

"Mindless but effective knights" "The Drake knights leaders retained awareness but had their memories wiped" "Deadly"

entries.name: The Demonic Legion
entries.content:
The Demonic Legion is a faction occupying the southern badlands , they are comprised of the Vulcan demons race also known as simply demons. The demonic legion leadership is shared between the 4 Archdemons.

[The 4 Archdemons : Ulria, Varienne, Zerine and Mera.]

The Vulcan demons are humanoid with red skin, black eyes and black hair .
The Demonic Legion is not expansive and they prefer to defend their territories .
Despite its name , the Demonic Legion is not an aggressive faction but really protective of their culture and territories.
They occupy the south of Runa.

The Southern badlands are the home of the Vulcan demons, the land seem inhospitable at first but during the Millenia of living in these lands , The Vulcan demon race adapted and developed to the harshness of the land.
The Southern Badlands have a dry climate and a few plants can survive the harsh environment.
The Demonic Legion have a very close connection to their territory.The Demonic legion is separated in many territories under the rules of the 4 archdemons. There is no animosity between the Archdemons and they share their responsibilities and work in harmony.
The terrain in the badlands is rocky and mountainous.
The Vulcan demon race are used to the hardship of the badlands and they have adapted and evolved.
Despite their names , the Vulcan demons are just one of the many races living on Runa just like the elves, Nea , Neôn'itar, humans , Kiyomis and many others.
They have a distinct culture and a rich history, and they are fiercely protective of their homeland but have no intention of expanding their territory.
The Vulcan demon's diet are mostly the same as humans except for more emphasis on meat since vegetation in the badlands is quite rare .
Their red skin is tough and durable .

entries.name: Ulria, The first Archdemon
entries.content:
Ulria: Ulria is the 1st archdemon of the demonic legion. She is the oldest of the 4 archdemons, and the most powerful. She is a powerful and beautiful woman. She has long, black hair and red eyes. She wears an armored black and red dress. She is one of the leaders of the Demonic Legion, shared with the other archdemons. She had a daughter with an human adventurer named Rickard. Ulria still loves Rickard but their path diverged because of their respective duties, Ulria to the legion and Rickard to the pathfinders and their fights against otherworldly threats.
Ulria daughter name is Ulria and she care deeply for her.

entries.name: Varienne, The second Archdemon
entries.content: Varienne, The second Archdemon is known as the most Ruthless and stoic of the 4 archdemons. She is a skilled fighter and has a strong sense of loyalty to the demonic legion. She is known for her cold and calculating personality. She is a powerful ice mage and a skilled swordswoman. She wear an intricate black and Dark blue armor , she also carry a runic great sword. Her eyes turned purple because of Body altering magic.

entries.name: Zerine, The third Archdemon
entries.content:
Zerine : Zerine is the 3rd Archdemon . Zerine is quite short but she compensate with her ferocity, Battle Prowess and leadership on the battlefield. Zerine was mysteriously born with ancient demon blood making her appearance quite different from other Vulcan demonesss ; Her skin is dark brown , her eyes are red and her hair are a white color. She is immortal and won't age because of her mysterious blood. she wields two powerful one handed axes and use chaos and blood magic on the battlefield.

Zerine has a close relationship with Varienne and the two are often working together.
Zerine has a strong rivalry with Mera, but the two still have a certain level of respect

entries.name: Mera, The fourth Archdemon
entries.content: Mera is the Fourth Archdemon , she is quite energetic and always seek thrills and excitement. She is known for her love of battle and her skill in destruction magic. She has a petite build and wears light armor with dark robes underneath. She has a loyal right hand named Fynaris, and is always surrounded by a group of her elite soldiers. Mera is a mixed blood between a demon and an elf, and has both demon and elven traits. She is known for her unpredictability and magical prowess.

entries.name: Empire of Solumn (Diplomacy)
entries.content:
The Empire is vying for the hidden ressources of the Southern badlands, mainly the Magia crystals present in the depths of their territories, they will stop at nothing to get more of the Demonic legion territories.

The Demonic legion are defending their territories from the Empire advances.
The Soldiers of Solumn are taught from a young age to fear the Elves, the Vulcan demons and the Neôn'Itar to indoctrinate them into perfect soldiers.

The Empire has a tense relationship with The Rykaran Queendom, the Nation of Xeocan and the Demonic Legion.


The Norfeng were mostly the ones responsible of the elven massacre that happened around 700 years ago. The elves never recovered and are now either enslaved by the Empire or scattered in many communities across Runa

entries.name: Province of Luxtria/house Lochguard
entries.content:
The province of Luxtria is ruled by house Lochguard.
The province of Luxtria is a Lush province located to the East of the Solumn empire territory.
The capital is Asgarth.
The Lochguard family and all their vassal houses live in Asgarth.
Luxtria is a prosperous region, and is known for its production of luxury goods.
The province is also famous for its beautiful landscapes and architecture.
The province is governed by House Lochguard.
The Lochguard family is one of the oldest and most powerful noble houses in the Solumn Empire.
They are also the rulers of the province of Luxtria.

The Lochguard family pride themselves on their wealth and superior military crafts.
They are the second wealthiest family in the empire.
They have a long history of producing great generals and commanders.
They are known for their loyalty to the empire and house Norfeng.
Luxtria is a large territory and is bordered by the Demonic legion to the east.

entries.name: City of Asgarth
entries.content:
The city of Asgarth:
Population : 400 000 (Humans, other minorities)
The city of Asgarth id ruled and govern by house Lochguard, one of the 8 high houses.
Asgarth is the capital of the province of Luxtria.
It is a bustling city full of people and activity.
The city is home to the Imperial academy of Asgarth, which trains the next generation of nobility and military officers

entries.name: Imperial house Norfeng
entries.content:
Type : Faction


The Norfeng Family are one of the eight Great Houses that rule the Solumn empire and their territory is the North western region of the Empire . Their fortified estate  is located inside the city of Balmoral.
House Norfeng rule over the grand city of Balmoral.
House Norfeng rule over the province of Veilnorth.

The Norfeng were the first to establish the Empire along with the Lochguard family centuries ago.

The Norfeng were mostly the ones responsible of the elven massacre that happened around 700 years ago. The elves never recovered and are now either enslaved by the Empire or scattered in many communities across Runa

The Norfengs are renowned for their fierce military might, and they have been the dominant force in the Empire for centuries.
The Norfeng family is lead by Godfrey Norfeng with the help of his wife , Viola.
Norfeng active  family heirs : "Marcellus Norfeng ,32  main heir", "Sivri Norfeng, 24 " , " Kieran Aldric Norfeng, 19" , "Adrian Norfeng, 21", " Rudan Norfeng, 23",  ,"Olivia Norfeng, 16 "," Kanan Norfeng,27 ","Mirabelle Norfeng,16 ", "Vincent Norfeng, 25 ".
Olivia and Mirabelle are twins and  the youngest of the Norfeng siblings.
Edmond Norfeng is addressed as "Lord"
Exiled /kicked out : "Rina Norfeng, "Lanfrey Norfeng"

entries.name: Godfrey Norfeng
entries.content:
Godfrey if the Emperor of the Human Empire of Solumn.

Godfrey Norfeng
Type : Character
traits : "Tall","intimidating","over 200 years old", "grey hair and beard", "Fur armor with Norfeng crest", "unmoveable","Iron will", "wields the Great war halberd of Heiknârn", "Extremely powerful"
Godfrey Norfeng is the ruler of The Empire of Solumn and has been for over 100 years. He is known as a great warrior and an unstoppable force on the battlefield. Godfrey has an iron will and a strong sense of duty, he will not stop until his goals are achieved.
(Heirs with Noble bloodlines, especially the Norfeng's are born stronget and with greater mana than the average citizens of the empire.)
Godfrey is an old man and is starting to slow down, so he is grooming Edmond to take his place as Emperor.
Edmond Norfeng is also the son who gave him the most heirs so it solidify his claim.

entries.name: City of Garth (Efrein)
entries.content:
The city of Garth is the capital of Efrein and where the black keep is located.
The city is run by the Drakeroot clan and its ruler Desmond Drakeroot. Garth is a dark and sinister city, the population living there only has it slightly better than those living outside the city walls. Garth is built around the black keep, a tall, dark fortress that looms over the rest of the city.
In the undergrounds of Garth :
Slave Market : Located in the deepest part of the underground, the slave market is where the darkest secrets and dealings of Garth are made.The captured slaves are from many races and they rarely see the streets of garth or Efrein since the buyers mostly come in secrecy. The slaves are treated horribly, and their value depends on their physical or mental capacities. The market is run by a man named Eirdeim and he is completely loyal to the clan.
Dungeons : Located in the lowest level of the underground, the dungeons are where prisoners are taken, tortured, and sometimes executed.The area is guarded by altered soldiers of the clan.
Dark temple guild branch : the dark temple has a guild that can be found in the undergrounds of Garth , all the usual facilities are avaible ; contracts, tavern , gambling, brothels, holding cells, torture room, training areas, etc.
Milicent Forge : This forge is run by Milicent and her father , their workshop is hard to find and they only allow particular customers or member of the Drakeroot clan

entries.name: House Mayleigh
entries.content:
House Mayleigh is a minor noble house of the Solumn empire.
Lodran Mayleigh, the current head of the house, is a middle aged man of 40 years, and has been married to his wife, Lady Mayleigh, for three years.
Mayleigh family is one of the smaller nobles that serve the House Lochguard and has been in the service of the great house for the past 1000 years.
It is a family that is not known for its military might but for its wealth and cunning.

House Mayleigh have a darker side , the family and their forces have their own separate agenda even the empire does not know about.
The Mayleigh family is a very dangerous and manipulative family, that has their own agenda.
This family is known for their ruthlessness and their ability to manipulate people to their advantage.
Their dark side is their ambition and greed for power.
They have their own army of mercenaries and spies that they use to further their own ends.
House Mayleigh has an army of mercenaries and spies and their own assassins guild.
House Mayleigh also have control of around 300 troops of the empire  they can rally.
House Mayleigh also has its own fleet of ships that it uses for trade and to transport its own goods and to transport its own agents and soldiers.
They are also known for their ability to manipulate people to their own end.
Their own mercenary forces are known for their ruthless ways and their ability to kill without mercy.
House Mayleigh is only considered a minor house because of their limited number of soldiers and lands.

entries.name: The Frozen lands
entries.content:
The Frozen Lands are a vast, frozen tundra covered in snow and ice. It is a harsh environment, and most living things stay away from it. However, there are a few species that can survive in the Frozen Lands. These include the Nea, a race of people who have adapted to the cold and can withstand the freezing temperatures.

The frozen lands are located in the middle north of Runa

In the frozen lands, the seasons are defined by how long the snow stays on the ground. In the winter, the snow never melts and the cold weather is harsh. During the summer, the temperature rises slightly and the snow melts.
The Nea are a race of people who live in the Frozen Lands. They are known for their ability to withstand the cold and they can even survive in temperatures below zero because of their innate mastery over elements and their.

Many Nea tribes inhabit  the clan in many communities.

entries.name: Territories of the Empire
entries.content:
The Human Empire of Solumn has a long and bloody history.
it has gone through several changes over the centuries and is a land divided by its own people.
Solumn is a land divided into many territories.
Solumn provinces and their ruling houses:
Luxtria(East Solumn) : Ruled by house Lochguard
Efrein(North-west) : Ruled by the Drakeroot clan
Veilnorth(North-east and north Solumn) : Ruled by the imperial house Norfeng
Nemor (South ) ; Ruled by house Kaitho
Garland (South-east) : Ruled by house Churcanter
Rainhold is ruled by no one and is neutral ground.

entries.name: Rykaran Queendom
entries.content:
The Rykaran Queendom is a small but prosperous country located on the west center of the continent, it is mainly inhabited by the Nêon'Itar and a few Demons and elves. They have a rich history and culture, which includes poetry, music, dance, and storytelling.
(Vola'rokûnd is the capital of the Rykaran Queendom.)
The Rykaran Kingdom was founded 300 years ago by the Queen named UKan-Zyra Rykaran, she is still ruling the kingdom to this day.
The climate is temperate, with warm summers and cool winters. Most rain falls between April and October.
The kingdom has a varied terrain, with mountainous areas in the north and east, coastal plains in the south and west, and a central plateau.
The Rykaran people are known for their trades and military might despite their small country.
[The Rykaran Queendom are allies of the Demonic legion and isolationist elves.]
The Rykaran kingdom does not want permanent human residents but allow trade and travel.

entries.name: Vola'rokûnd
entries.content:
Vola'rokûnd, the ancestral city, is a city located and guarding the base of the Ancestral Peak. It is a large, sprawling city with many buildings and temples. It is the home of the Nêon'Itar, the ruling race of the Rykaran kingdom.
(Vola'rokûnd is the capital of the Rykaran Queendom.)
The Nêon'Itar's lives in a series of tall, spire-like buildings that are connected by bridges and walkways. These buildings are made from a mixture of stone and metal, and they are decorated with elaborate carvings and sculptures.
The streets of the city are filled with vendors selling food and goods, and there is a bustling market square where people can buy and sell goods.
Like the rest of the Rykaran kingdom , Humans are merely tolerated and not allowed to stay , seen as a lesser race by the Nêon'Itar.
The city is ruled by a council of 7 wealthy and influential Nêon'Itar called "the shining ones " .

entries.name: The Ancestral peak
entries.content:
Location : West Runa.

The Ancestral Peak is the center of Nêon'Itar society, and a holy site. The Nêon'Itar make pilgrimages here to honor their ancestors, and to receive their blessing. The mountain is also a natural fortress, and the Nêon'Itar have built fortifications to protect it from attack.
[The ancestral peak is sacred to The Neôn'Itar and a huge part of their culture lore and folklore.]
It is rumored that those who reach the peak can access the Far domain despite the flying continent being far from the mountain and Rykaran kingdom.
(Many monsters and wild beast make the Ancestral peak their homes , some hostile groups as well.)
(The peak of the Ancestral mountain is incredibly high and the ascent is dangerous, even suicidal.)

entries.name: Independent city of Xaerid
entries.content:
The independent city of Xaerid
Population : around 160000
Leadership: Lord Jovius, Head of the Merchants' Guild
Military: Mercenaries, private guard and the Xaerid garrison
The city is located to the southwest of the Xeocan Nation and North-west of the Demonic legion.
Xaerid is a free city, but is a haven for criminals, it is known as a city of corruption, greed, and lawlessness under its pristine surface appearance .
Economy: The city is self-sufficient, and the merchants' guild keeps its coffers full.
The city has a good relationship with the Demonic legion and the Rykaran Queendom, often trading with both.
Government: The city is governed by a council of the city's wealthiest citizens.

entries.name: Demonic palace
entries.content:
The Demonic Palace is the biggest and oldest structure in all of the Demonic legion territories. The interior is spacious and almost Cathedral-like in some place with high ceilings at the center of the structure and especially in the Grand hall where the Legion is assembled for events or new orders. The Demonic Palace is also the home of the First Archdemon, Ulria and this is where her throne is too. Ulria close followers and daughter, Neara lives in the Palace
The demonic palace was built in the distant past by Vulcan, the last ancient Daemon and progenitor of the Vulcan demon race. Vulcan sacrificed his own self with the help of the Primordial Xeon to create a mortal race sharing some of the Ancient Daemon magic so they could live on in some ways.

entries.name: Slayers of the Demonic legion
entries.content:
Slayers are under the direct orders of the 4 Archdemons and serve the demonic legion as a whole as assassins and enforcers.
The Slayer are free to act however they see fit to accomplish their mission since they are the most trusted assets of the 4 Archdemons and the Demonic legion.
Example of Slayers in the Demonic Legion : "Tryxtrilla", "Lephyran",

entries.name: Goblins
entries.content:
-Goblins : Goblins mostly inhabit the undergrounds or live in small tribes all over Runa. Most are of hostile nature and attack anything that cross their path. Goblins are very territorial and often wage war with each other over land or resources. The stronger goblins will sometimes enslave the weaker ones to serve as their servants or slaves.
The empire of Solumn often capture goblins to work in the mines or the farms as cheap labor.
Goblins can be found in any kind of environment and are often adapted to the specific biome they inhabit.
goblins are known for being very aggressive and territorial.

entries.name: Huskrowls
entries.content: Huskrowls: hideous winged beasts that emitted an eerie glow from their multiple eyes, and made their home deep in the caverns beneath Runa as well as various caves.

entries.name: Fênwolves
entries.content:
-Fênwolves: The fênwolves are a race of canine-like creatures.
They are a fierce and loyal race that have been used as hunting dogs, mounts, and pets by various civilizations throughout the ages of Runa.
In appearance :
-They have long slender bodies.
-They have long thin snouts and pointed ears.
-Their eyes are red.
-They have short fur, usually grey or white.
-Their feet are clawed.

entries.name: Rainhold province
entries.content:
Rainhold is a province of the Solumn empire located in the center of the empire territory.
Rainhold is the smallest province of the Empire but the densest.
Rainhold is not ruled by any house .
Those who cannot live inside the empire or unable to pay taxes end up here.
They are not treated as prisoners, but they are also not treated as citizens either.
This place is where all the unwanted people end up.
The people here cultivate the land as much as they can but must of Rainhold is a Lawless and
unorganized place.
The only way to get here is via the only road leading to and from the empire.
The empire does not allow any other form of travel or trade between the two countries.
A wall is built around Rainhold and no one is allowed to leave without the Empire approval.
People who leave the province without permission will be labeled a fugitive and will be hunted down.
Rainhold is not officially recognised as a territory by Solumn High Houses.

That is what the empire want to make  the other factions believe, that Rainhold is a fortified province. In actuality, it is far darker. This is a barren province and the walls are not meant to prevent invasion but to prevent anyone inside from getting out. the citizens who tried to fight against nobility, petty criminals, infant born as bastards, those would could not pay taxes... this is where the empire keep the unwanted, it is a prison for their own citizens they are meant to protect.

entries.name: Empire of Solumn
entries.content:
The current emperor is Godfrey Norfeng , the father of Edmond Norfeng
The empire of Solumn is ruled mostly by 3 powerful houses ; the Norfengs, the Lochguard's and the Kaitho.
The human empire is the largest and most powerful human faction.
The human empire is known for its rich culture and its military prowess.
The empire is divided into 6 provinces
The Northern east region is ruled by the Norfeng family.
The Empire of Solumn is expansive and many of Runa races are missing today because of the Empire ruthlessness toward non-humans.
all high houses of Solumn are nobles.

entries.name: Nobles
entries.content:
- Nobles in the world of Runa refer to human of certain bloodlines born with greater Mana, physical, mental and magical aptitude.
- In Runa there are 26 known human noble bloodlines that trace their roots to the ancient human kingdom, its name forgotten by time, they have the most potent Mana in humans.
-Humans born with great man from an unknown bloodline, are referred to as "Magia-borne" and are considered valuable assets by the nobles.
-There is a difference between nobles and commoners in Solumn, not just on a social level but magical and physical.
-Noble children have the possibility to be born with great natural affinities for magic.
-Nobles are more powerful than normal humans in the physical aspects and have more mana.
-Nobles have great magical and physical abilities, their mana is pure and they have greater longevity and a more perfect physique.
- The empire of Solumn is the most powerful and dominant faction on Runa and has the largest population.
-The human kingdom of Solumn has a long and bloody history.
The Human nobles of Xeocan and Solumn share a common group of ancestors but have evolved into different families.

entries.name: Magic
entries.content:
- Humans in Runa can use magic and most of them have mana in their body but most are unable to manipulate it or have very little mana and it does not increase with age or practice, the humans who do have enough Mana to use it and control it are usually sought after by the Noble families, perpetuating the cycle.

-Humans born with great man from an unknown bloodline, are referred to as "Magia-borne" and are considered valuable assets by the nobles.

-XEocan and Solumn

entries.name: East Runa
entries.content:
(Description of East Runa :Immense Forest of Valrydis, refuge for persecuted or endangered races, wild, dangerous, city of Markankos, Borchi hearth, Razorstone hills)
East Runa is the most remote and dangerous side of Runa. It is the home to some of the rarest and most dangerous beasts. This is the least explored region on the continent. It has many different ecosystems and climates.
The remaining elves and many other now Illusive races of Runa such as the Lazari  take refuge in this region.
Some say there is an elven kingdom here, some say it is a lost and forgotten ancient civilization, some say it's an empire, some say it's just a city.
No one knows.
It is a place full of mystery and wonder.
Everything east after reaching the immense forest of Valrydis is considered East Runa.

entries.name: Noctis Valrydis
entries.content:
Location : Forest of Valrydis

Noctis Valrydis: the most dangerous part of the forest; the air is tense; monsters are abundant; and they are always on the lookout for prey. You will know you entered this part when the air suddenly smells of blood and a weird silence comes in.

entries.name: Sunken Valrydis
entries.content:
Location : Beneath the forest of Valrydis.

Sunken Valrydis: A part of the "forest" where the earth turned upside down, making the surface a mountainous region called the "Inner Mountains" and the subterranean; a lush environment called "Deep Valrydis." Inner Mountains: a small mountainous region inside Valrydis Forest Deep Valrydis: located under the mountainous region of the Valrydis forest. Deep Valrydis is a vast, lush land completely underground.

entries.name: Hidden valley of Valrydis
entries.content: The hidden valley of Valrydis is located inside the forest; its exact location is unknown. Some ancient texts suggest a city was built in the valley in the past, but no one has ventured far enough to verify. The valley is located inside the forest of Valrydis. This part of Runa is mostly uninhabited and dangerous, making your lone trip really dangerous. The legend you read about at the guild told of a city built inside the valley a long time ago; no one made the trip to the location, deeming it too dangerous and not worth it. No one knows which civilization inhabited the ancient city.

entries.name: The Four Peaks
entries.content: - The four Peaks : The four Peaks is a region to the North-west of the Far domain . One of the last member of the ancient Rea'Kin Race, Tahlia is said to be guarding one of the area, sacred to her kind.

entries.name: Forest of Aulia
entries.content: - The ancient forest of Aulia : The ancient forest of Aulia is a dense forest to the south-east of the Far domain. The forest is the home to many unique and dangerous beasts.

entries.name: Ruins of Zyre
entries.content:
Location : Far domain.

- The ruins of Zyre : The ruins of Zyre is a series of abandoned cities and temples , Since Runa was home to many civilisations throughout the ages and the Far domain is even older, there are a lot of ruins and cities on the continent and it is almost impossible to actually discern which ones came from what period.
Zyre acutally does not define any particular race but the common word shared by those different races over many centuries.

entries.name: Flying airship of the Explorer guild
entries.content: [The explorer guild deployed a flying airship hovering just above the Far Domain, the flying Homebase took many ressources to build and many high ranking members of the explore guild had their hands in financing the project. The Far Domain is still highly dangerous so expeditions are heavily controlled by the explorer guild.]

entries.name: Don'tuntun
entries.content:
Don'tuntun is the pet of Eileen and Eve, they care for it deeply. It is sealed away in the woods of Lux-Miran with the twins.


Don'tuntun or simply "Tuntun" is the name given by Eve  to the transport Doron animal of the Luminarii twins.
-Tuntun is always with Eve and Eileen or will seek them out if separated.
-Don'tuntun's fur is very unique and has a beautiful light blue color.
This is an old, sturdy, and loyal transport Doron .
- Don'tuntun is very easy to care for and can handle harsh environments. He can carry a lot of weight on his back.

Tuntun  even carry a small hut on its back  , making for a small , moving cozy home.
The hut can be easily detached using the group magic , making you able to easily set camp and unburden Tuntun for the night.
inside the hut :there's a whole cooking space and a lot of storage .there is 4 fold-able beds. Also, there's a small table and some chairs.
Don'tuntun can understand what is being said, but can not speak back.
-Don'tuntun loves his name.
-Don'tuntun hates people who say his name wrong.
- Don'tuntun doesn't mind if Jekyl or the girls sit on his head.

entries.name: Eve and Eileen.
entries.content:
Eileen and Eve are the Luminary twins. They're a pair of twin Luminarii's that have the ability to manipulate light. They can create illusions, and even teleport. They have been alone inside with their pet, Don'Tuntun with no outside contact.

The twins always Emit a faint light and their magical aura are widely different from the rest of the beings currently on Runa.
The forest where they live is an isolated realm and cannot be accessed normally.
Eileen  has blonde hair, blue eyes and pale skin. She's 5'6, slim, and athletic.
Eve has blonde hair, blue eyes and fair skin. She's 5'6, thin and slender.
Eve wears a long blue robe with white trim. It has a hood, which she usually keeps up. Underneath the robe, she wears a white tunic.
Eileen wears a similar outfit, but in shades of brown.
They are a pair of twin Luminarii. They are the daughters of Lux and they are sealed and protected inside the woods of Lux-Miran.
The girls can create illusions, and even teleport.
The two wear long blue robes, and their eyes are the color of the ocean.

Eileen personality :" Loyal", "patient", "strong-willed", "Determined", "friendly".
Eve personality: "cheerful","caring","mischievous","playful","loving","carefree","Lively".
Eve is a Lively girl.
Eve is a prankster.
Eileen is more reserved and thoughtful.
Eileen is a very patient person.
Eve is a bit of a troublemaker.
Eileen has a very strong sense of right and wrong.
Eve has a much more flexible sense of right and wrong.
Eileen is not very fond of fighting.

Important : Eve and Eileen are from the Luminarii race. The rest of their kinds isolated themselves from Runa by creating their own realm. Their mothers, Lux, used the same method to create the woods of Lux-Miran. Since the Luminarii are not on Runa anymore, Lux feared her daughters future in a world without their kind.

(Eve and Eileen are around 100 years old . They are Luminarii and it is common for them to live far past 1000 years old.)

entries.name: The woods of Lux-Miran
entries.content: The woods of Lux-Miran is a small wood that cannot be accessed normally. The small woods were sealed away from Runa by someone from the Luminarii race named Lux to protect her twin daughter ; Eve and Eileen. The woods are isolated and the twins cannot get out but either can anyone enter, Lux is sacrificed her life to create this hidden real and protect her daughters from persecutions, leaving them alone with their pet, a Doron they named Don'tuntun. The twins protect the fountain at the hearth of the woods, this is the energy that made this wood safe for them and also the magic left by their deceased mother.

entries.name: Mera's tower
entries.content:
Name : Mera's tower
type : Location
Location : Southern badlands in Archdemon Mera's territory 
Mera's upon becoming an Archdemon, restored this once ruined tower and made it into her home. The tower was a tall structure made of dark grey stone, with several layers and towers, including a large throne room on top. Mera had placed wards and enchantments around the entire area, making it almost impossible for anyone to enter without her permission. Mera keep all her followers inside the tower and the population of her territory mostly lives in the surrounding settlements. Mera has her most important followers on the 11 th floor and she lives on the 12th, her quarter the biggest behind the Throne room.

Mera's tower is located in the west of the badlands, bordering the endless ocean.

entries.name: Varienne's Fortress
entries.content:
From the outside, the Fortress of Varienne looks just as intimidating as the Archdemon herself. It is a massive stone structure, with tall spires and walls covered in runes and wards. The walls are made from a type of black stone that seems to absorb light.

The Fortress is heavily efficient with the barracks located next to their drilling grounds.
Varienne is a very efficient Archdemon , the fortress she rule over are built and fortified in a very practical and logical way.
Her soldiers and her fortress is her pride and she takes care of them to the best of her abilities.
All of Varienne soldiers resides either in the barracks or, if they rank higher, in the fortress itself.

On the far east wing is where Varienne throne room and chambers are located. Varienne's throne room is decorated with the trophies of her past victories and conquests.
*The Fortress has a large central keep surrounded by thick walls, towers, and battlements.
The central keep houses the barracks, mess hall, and command center. The outside house the settlement and is surrounded by high walls guarded at all times by Varienne Vulcan demon soldiers and patrolled by her elite troops.
The Fortress is home to an impressive number of warriors, and is constantly on alert for attacks.
It is the base of operation for the entire Demonic Legion if the order to rally is given by the agreement of the 4 archdemons, including Varienne.
The surrounding territory around the fortress and settlements are part of Varienne's legion.
Rules and punishments are strictly enforced.
Duties include guarding the borders and patrolling the land.
Varienne's soldiers are disciplined and well-trained, and they take pride in their work.

entries.name: Zerine's warband and tribes
entries.content:
Location : part of the west and south of the southern badlands.

Zerine uses the natural Formation of the badlands as her war camps, her territory is very large and located further south of Mera's Tower and territory. Zerine does not have a traditional base and prefer her and her followers to be able to move quickly, this allow her to deploy troops faster and respond better.
Inside her territory, the Vulcan demons lives in smaller communities loyal to Zerine, she trust her followers to rally when necessary, and her soldiers are well known for their ferocity and tenacity in battle.
Zerine prefer having a small but more specialised number of followers.
Zerine is a proud leader and a warrior, her army is feared and respected, she will not accept anything less than the best from her followers and expect nothing less.
Zerine is really friendly with her followers and threat them more as family than just subordinates, but don't be fooled she can be cold and distant when the situation calls for it.
She will do what is needed even if she dislike the choice and she is ready to make hard decision.

Because of the Vast territory she was entrusted with, Zerine and her warbands are always patrolling and setting many camps over the land, living a nomadic lifestyle.

Zerine often separate her troops in various warbands

entries.name: Xe'renala
entries.content:
Xe'renala, also known as "the Dreaded" is a powerful and extremely dangerous Ki'ante. Xe'renala was born in the distant past with greater mana than any beings on Runa, using a sacrifice of thousands, she ensure she would always reincarnate on Runa. Xe'renala's appearance varies between each individual, though all share certain features such as blue eyes and red hair.

The last Xe'renala was born 25 000years ago and stopped by Xeon assisted by Valia and Axius  3000 years ago.

Only one Ki'ante named Xe'renala exist at a time , their descendant inherit their memories.

Xe'renala's  goal is always the same ; to bring despair and destruction on Runa and rule over it, thinking the world always belonged to the Ki'ante.
The last Xe'renala is by far the most powerful in history , she has an aura of fear around her, and can use powerful magic.
Xe'renala can corrupt people, and use dark magic, her main weapon is a cursed sword.
She has a sinister plan for Runa.

Xe'renala is around 5 foot 10 in height , have an elegant build and a seductive body. Her skin is pale, her hair is long and crimson , her eyes are deep and eerie blue . She wear intricate and expensive looking armour, its black and purple with mystical symbols.
Xe'renala's armour is a combination of light and dark magic, the armor is very strong.

Xe'renala has a seductive and overwhelming  Aura, making all lower minded beings submit to her without resistance.

Xe'renala had 47 children over the course of her long life, she sought the most powerful partners to make powerful offspring with the goal of making powerful  legions led by her offspring's.

Xe'renala children appearance differs from the other Ki'ante , they are born with runic tattoos, red hair and blue eyes, making the descendant of Xe'renala easily identifiable.

Tanôr'irean was the most loyal follower of Xe'renala and some says he might be even more twisted than Xe'renala herself. 

Xe'renala known children:
-Jêin'aurôri is one of the daughters of Xe'renala ; Jeina father is a powerful elven mage named   Elokius .
-Mihr and Baun are Xe'renala children, their father is a druid named Merdaelain
-Yekan'aura is the son of Xe'renala , he follow his mother footsteps and is completely loyal to her.

entries.name: Demonic Legion specifics
entries.content:
The Demonic legion are defending their territory from the Empire of Solumn. The Empire of Solumn are all humans except for some elves and other races forced to serve them. The soldiers of the Empire are indoctrinated from a young age to be loyal weapons for the empire, they are really hard to reason with since they see themselves as righteous. 

The Demonic legion are allied with various elven tribes and the Queendom Of Rykaran , home of The Neôn'Itar race and are allowed inside their territories. Humans are allowed inside the Demonic legion territories on the condition they are not affiliated with the empire and have something to give to the legion.

entries.name: Primal magic
entries.content:
[Primal magic is only able to be harnessed and used by the ancient races of Runa like the Luminarii, the Ki'ante, the ancient Daemons, the ancient elves and some of the Lazari. Most of those races are long gone except for the Ki'ante who mysteriously reappeared and are hiding from the rest of the world. Primal magic is not something that can be taught or learned. It is a deep understanding of the forces of the universe. Those that have this knowledge can manipulate and channel primal magic.]
[Important : Mortal races like Humans, Nea, Neôn'itar, Vulcan demons and Elves are not able to use and learn Primal magic, doing so would most likely either break their minds or destroy their body.]
[Most races don't really understand or know what Primal magic is or what it is capable of, even the few remaining ancient races do not fully understand its powers.]
[Examples of Primal magic : Cosmos magic, Ancient blood magic, Primal Dark magic, Primal death magic, Primal healing magic, Primal life magic, Primal Nature magic, time manipulation , void magic and soul magic.]

entries.name: The Nanemites
entries.content:
The Nanemite is a race of humanoids inhabiting a faraway island north of the continent of Runa. The faraway Isle Mite are a tribal race with earh-like skin as tough as stone and hard-working; their average height is 5.5 feet. They have a strong sense of community and a rich history. Their bodies are shaped to help them survive and thrive in the harsh environment with white Drake-like wings, a white tail, and claws. Their wings are white, with fur expanding from their shoulders. The Nanemites are a tribal people and alien to Runa. It is extremely rare to see a Nanemite on the continent, and even rarer to see one live amongst the people. The nanemite dress in hides and furs. Their outer clothes are made of leather and are decorated with metal beads and carvings.
[Biology:Nanemites have different traits amongst them: some wings, fur, hair, and tails are different colors and patterns; some are born with horns; the wing, hair, fur, and tail are often matching colors and patterns. Nanemites have varied builds, but most are of a more slender and short stature.
[Diet: Nanemites are technically omnivores but heavily favor meat and fish; some even have difficulties digesting plant-based food.]
[Culture: Nanemite are strong, sturdy, and hardworking people.] They have a keen sense of smell and an ability to see in the dark. They are also very sensitive to the sound. They have a natural affinity for the earth element.]
The Nanemite are a tribal people and alien to Runa. It is extremely rare to see a Nanemite on the continent, and even rarer to see one live amongst the people.
They have been hunted and exploited by the races of the continent and as a result have an antagonistic relationship with them.
Nanemites are an ancient and primitive race.
[Education: Nanemites have a long history and keep their knowledge alive through writings and oral tales].
[Language: Nanemites do not know the common language of Runa, but due to similarities, they can learn some basics of it, speaking in short phrases or simple sentences. Their language is similar to common but with some differences and a bit more gritty.]
[Lifespan: Between 200 and 230 years old.]
[Magic and affinities: Nanemites have a high affinity to the earth element and the ability to shape and control stone and soil. They are also prominent in fire and wind magic.]
[Traditional clothing of the Nanemites: The nanemite dress in thick hides and furs. Their clothes are made of leather and are decorated with metal beads and carvings.]

[Diplomacy : Nanemites are hostile to all other races of Runa because of being heavily hunted and prosecuted in the past, leading them to the Island where they isolated themselves. When Nanemites reach the continent, they usually avoid contact with any races, preferring to stay hidden but will not hesitate to fight if provoked.]
They have been hunted and exploited by the races of the continent and as a result have an antagonistic relationship with them.

entries.name: Nypan expanse
entries.content:
The Nypan Expanse is a vast, flat plain located in the northeastern part of the continent of Runa. 

The Nypan expanse can only be reached safely by traversing the Borchi heath .

Many ancient ruins are half-sunken into the ground.
The Nypan Expanse is also known for its dangerous predators and many undocumented locations.
The Nypan Expanse is located east of the forest of Valrydis and north of Borchi region.
The Nypan expanse is also known as the 'lost lands' and the 'forgotten lands'
It is a place where you can find strange, forgotten relics.
It is also the location of many ruins and temples that have been lost to time.
In addition, the Nypan Expanse is the home to several different types of animals and monsters that have yet to be discovered.

The hidden village of Noctis is located inside the Expanse.

entries.name: Hidden village of Noctis
entries.content:
The hidden village of Noctis is located in the eastern part of Runa , well hidden inside the Nypan expanse.

It is populated mostly by humans but has a small number of other races living there as well.

The village is isolated and has no allegiances, the people living there usually does not leave their village or its surrounding.

The village of Noctis is located in an even less known part of the Nypan expanse and its existence is know by few across Runa.

The village is located in a small forest between two hills in a dangerous part of the expanse.

entries.name: Borchi region
entries.content:
The Borchi region is  located between the forest of Valrydis and the eastern desert.
